name: El meu cor no para de bategar amb l'R1!
source:
Pick a lot of completely pointless choices and reach absurd endings!
Get on a train! (Or at least make it to the station).
A magical adventure that will make you fall in love with MEMFE <3.

[Translated from [url=https://patatatxan.itch.io/el-meu-cor-no-para-de-bategar-amb-lr1]Itch[/url]]
translation:
尽管选择毫无意义，也要尽情乱选，抵达荒诞结局！

快上火车！（至少也要赶到车站。）

一场奇幻冒险，会让你爱上MEMFE <3。

[译自[url=https://patatatxan.itch.io/el-meu-cor-no-para-de-bategar-amb-lr1]Itch.io[/url]]
